services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure on the water! Ride our high-performance jet skis and experience the rush of speed as you explore the iconic Santa Monica Pier, Venice Beach, and the beautiful Southern California coastline. Feel the ocean breeze, see dolphins, enjoy the nonstop thrill of piloting your own watercraft! Whether you’re a first-time rider or an experienced thrill seeker, there’s no better way to experience the coast than on one of our WaveRunners. services.name: 17 ft Boston Whaler (90 hp)
services.desc: There’s nothing like a classic. The 170 Montauk embodies the timeless look of Boston Whaler’s past, with simple lines, low-maintenance construction and pristine finish, while embracing new and modern craftsmanship like quiet-running, fuel-efficient standard 90-hp FourStroke outboard power. Sport fishermen and pleasure cruisers alike will enjoy the 170 Montauk’s modified-V hull, which ensures quick planing and a smooth, dry ride. Its no coincidence you see Boston Whaler hanging off the back of luxury motor yachts in many exotic ports.
